architecture.title: The Harness Bench — two halves, three graders, a registered plan
architecture.caption: EXAMPLE design for this course, run on the SIM agent. The nightly loop reads only the refine half. A version is frozen, then run three times per test task. Code graders and the safety graders run on every trial; the SIM judge grades one dimension at a time and routes Unknown to a human; the judge is accepted only above the human-agreement floor. The criteria are read back from a file written before any arm ran.
